q: Do I need to sign up?
a: No. There is no sign-in or sign-up anywhere on the site. Open the page, drop a file, download the result.

q: Why does the first conversion of a new type take a moment?
a: The converter for that family (PDF, spreadsheets, HEIC, AAC and so on) is fetched the first time it is needed and then cached by your browser. Later conversions of the same kind start instantly.

q: What is the file size limit?
a: It depends on the type, because everything has to fit in the browser’s memory: images 80 MB, documents 60 MB, spreadsheets 60 MB, audio 250 MB, 3D models 250 MB, video 600 MB and archives 800 MB. Video re-encoding is limited to 15 minutes of footage.

q: Why is a format missing from the To list?
a: Because that particular pair would not produce a meaningful result, or because your browser cannot encode it. A video cannot honestly become a Word document, and Chrome cannot write AVIF without extra help. The Formats tab shows exactly what your browser can do.
